clue.text: Sailor has many chats at sea

indicators.note: being at sea means confused and all over the place, so the letters get rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A seafarer passes the time on board with plenty of conversation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' is a link; 'at sea' rearranges MANY and CHATS, nine letters in all.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sails a pleasure boat is a sailor.

clue.text: May echo round the Tirol, fundamentally

definitions.text: May echo round the Tirol, fundamentally

parts.words: May echo round the Tirol, fundamentally
parts.note: describes the traditional warbling call of Alpine herdsmen, which bounces off the mountains of the Austrian Tyrol and is basic to its folk culture

explanation.surface: A remark about sound carrying in the Austrian Alps.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alpine singing style, flipping between chest voice and falsetto, is known for echoing off mountainsides.

clue.text: Cretins fall in reservoir

indicators.note: to fall in is to collapse, so the word cretins tumbles into a new order

explanation.surface: Some fools tumble into a body of water.
explanation.definitionFit: A tank storing water is a small reservoir.

clue.text: Head of team was quick to criticise change

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter, here taken from team

parts.note: to run is to be quick on your feet; ran is the past form
to slate is to criticise harshly

explanation.surface: A team captain hurried to find fault.
explanation.definitionFit: Rendering words into another language changes them, so the verb can mean convert or alter.

clue.text: People admit little girl to theatre for "The Magician"

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so the other pieces go inside the word for people

parts.note: men are people
Di is a short form of the girl's name Diana
a cinema is a picture theatre

explanation.surface: A crowd lets a child into a show to watch a conjuror.
explanation.walkthrough: 'admit' splits the word for people after its second letter; 'for' is only a link, and the answer is a tribal healer rather than a stage conjuror.
explanation.definitionFit: A tribal healer credited with supernatural powers is a kind of magician.

clue.text: What's the point in putting hair up?

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting a word up means writing it from bottom to top
in a down clue, putting a word up means writing it from bottom to top

parts.note: a bun is hair coiled at the back of the head

explanation.surface: Someone asks why bother pinning one's hair up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'putting ... up' turns BUN; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The crux or gist of a matter is its central point.

clue.text: More prudent way to run

parts.note: wise is an old word for manner or way, as in 'in no wise'
R is the cricket abbreviation for a run

explanation.surface: Someone suggests the most sensible route for a jog.
explanation.definitionFit: Being more sensible and judicious means being more prudent.

clue.text: Wife loves her Cockney beau

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, and O looks like a zero, so two loves give OO
a Cockney drops the H, saying 'er for her

explanation.surface: A wife adores her East End sweetheart.
explanation.walkthrough: A Cockney is a Londoner from the East End, known for dropping initial H sounds.
explanation.definitionFit: A suitor courting someone is their boyfriend or admirer.

clue.text: Officer joins in outright retreat

indicators.note: the officer joins in, going inside the word for outright

parts.note: sheer means utter or outright
Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant, an officer

explanation.surface: A soldier takes part in a full-scale withdrawal.
explanation.definitionFit: A refuge or hideaway is a retreat, a place of cover.

clue.text: Stand for engineers here

parts.note: RE stands for the Royal Engineers of the British Army
present means here, as in a roll-call reply

explanation.surface: Engineers turn up to be counted.
explanation.definitionFit: To symbolise or act on behalf of something is to stand for it.

clue.text: One's vehicle housed in divine shed

indicators.note: the pieces are housed in, that is placed inside, the abbreviation for a divine

parts.note: DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian or divine
one is I in Roman numerals, so one's is I'S
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone keeps their car in a garden shed belonging to a clergyman.
explanation.definitionFit: To throw away or cast off something is to shed it.

clue.text: Weep in bar after retirement bender

indicators.note: the word for weep is placed inside the reversed bar
retiring means going back, so the word for bar is read backwards

parts.note: a pub is a bar
to weep can mean to ooze, as a wound does

explanation.surface: A newly retired person cries into their drink after a heavy session.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after retirement' makes BUP; 'in' then puts the weeping word inside it. 'Bender' is slang for a drinking spree, not something that bends.
explanation.definitionFit: A drinking spree or binge is a bender in slang.

clue.text: City is in the forefront, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the words are judged by how they sound when spoken

parts.note: someone who is at the front leads

explanation.surface: A town claims to be ahead of the pack.
explanation.walkthrough: LEEDS is a large city in Yorkshire, northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: A major northern English urban centre is a city.

clue.text: As conveyed by name, Gareth is not complete weed

indicators.note: something conveyed by another is carried in it, so the shortened name sits inside

parts.note: to cite is to name or mention

indicators.note: not complete means the last letter of Gareth is cut off

parts.note: taken as written, a man's name

explanation.surface: Gareth's description of a smoke is left unfinished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not complete' leaves the name four of its five letters; 'conveyed by' puts them inside the verb for name. 'As' and 'is' are links, and weed is slang for tobacco.
explanation.definitionFit: Tobacco is jokingly called the weed, so a smoke rolled in paper is one.

clue.text: "Blue-yellow mixture needs more blue", said trader

parts.note: mixing blue and yellow paint gives green

indicators.note: said means the word is spoken, giving a sound-alike

parts.note: blue can mean smutty, so more blue is grosser

explanation.surface: An artist mixing paint calls for an extra dash of blue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs' is a link; GROSSER spoken gives GROCER.
explanation.definitionFit: A shopkeeper selling fruit and vegetables is a kind of trader.

clue.text: A layer in the nimbostratus

indicators.note: the letters are found running inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A remark about a band of grey rain cloud.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird that lays eggs is a layer.

clue.text: Pass quickly put an end to game

parts.note: to hop is to make a quick trip or pass across
to scotch a plan is to put an end to it

explanation.surface: A footballer passes the ball fast to finish the match.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the children's game of hopping between chalked squares.
explanation.definitionFit: A children's playground pastime of hopping through squares is a game.

clue.text: Becoming nine, Aurelia is a bonnie girl

indicators.note: becoming means turning into something else, so the letters form a new word

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Aurelia is turning nine and is a pretty child.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' is a link; the answer is the title of a well-known Scottish love song about a bonnie lass.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scottish song celebrates a beautiful young woman, whom it calls bonnie.

clue.text: A lot in a city on a hill

parts.note: NY is New York, a city
a mount is a hill

explanation.surface: Plenty of land sits in a city built on a hill.
explanation.definitionFit: Plenty or as much as you like is a large quantity.

clue.text: Allowance — small one, in Mary's case

parts.note: pocket means small, as in a pocket edition

indicators.note: the word for one goes inside the case of Mary
a word's case is its outer shell, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A girl's purse holds a tiny coin.
explanation.definitionFit: A child's regular weekly sum from parents is their allowance.

clue.text: Sails south to take soundings

parts.note: canvas is the cloth of sails, and stands for them

explanation.surface: A yacht heads south while depths are measured.
explanation.definitionFit: To poll opinion is to take soundings among people.

clue.text: Make ready for an attack

definitions.meaning: a sudden bout, as of coughing or rage

explanation.surface: Someone prepares for a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: To equip or prepare is to fit out; a sudden bout of illness or temper is a fit.

clue.text: New design for freight plane

indicators.note: a new design rearranges the parts, here the letters of freight

explanation.surface: A cargo aircraft is redesigned.
explanation.definitionFit: A military warplane built to attack others is a type of plane.

clue.text: Books a counterfeiter has concealed in a box, perhaps

indicators.note: the counterfeiter hides the other pieces inside himself

parts.note: a coiner makes forged money
NT is the New Testament, a collection of books

explanation.surface: A forger hides ledgers in a crate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has concealed in' places the books and the A after the second letter of the forger's word; a coiner is an old term for a maker of fake coins.
explanation.definitionFit: A box is one example of a receptacle; 'perhaps' marks the example.

clue.text: For instance Jonathan, a heartless father, is soaked in drink

indicators.note: the shortened father is soaked inside the drink

parts.note: ale is a drink

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter is removed

parts.note: pop is a word for father

explanation.surface: A man called Jonathan, a cruel father, is drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: Jonathan is a variety of eating fruit; 'a' is a link and POP loses its centre O to give PP.
explanation.definitionFit: Jonathan is a named variety of the orchard fruit.

clue.text: Magnate makes a pile on the piste

definitions.meaning: a mound of hard snow on a ski slope

explanation.surface: A tycoon builds up a heap on a ski run.
explanation.definitionFit: A tycoon is a powerful businessman; on ski slopes a bump of packed snow has the same name.

clue.text: Caterpillar right in the middle of rock

indicators.note: the letter for right goes inside the word for rock

parts.note: lava is molten rock, which cools to stone

explanation.surface: A grub sits in a crevice in a boulder.
explanation.definitionFit: A caterpillar is the immature stage of a butterfly or moth.

clue.text: Hobo will, they say, walk all over

indicators.note: they say means the words are spoken aloud as a sound-alike

parts.note: a hobo is a tramp, and will is shortened to 'll

explanation.surface: A vagrant intends to stride all over the place.
explanation.definitionFit: To crush underfoot is to walk all over.

clue.text: 5280 ft up, without one tree

indicators.note: without means the letter for one is taken out
in a down clue, up means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: a mile is 5280 feet
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone climbs a mile high, alone, past a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns MILE into ELIM, then I goes.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall deciduous hardwood is a tree.

clue.text: Meet in the bar

definitions.meaning: to answer or oppose an attack
the serving surface in a shop or pub

explanation.surface: Two friends meet at the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: To counter is to meet an attack with a response; a shop's serving surface is a bar.

clue.text: Expedition hates to be diverted

indicators.note: diverted means sent a different way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An exploring party dislikes detours.
explanation.definitionFit: Expedition can mean promptness or speed, as in expeditious.

clue.text: Turned mean, speaker enters and stays

indicators.note: the speaker enters, going inside the turned word
turned means the word for mean is reversed

parts.note: to mean is to aim or intend
an orator is a public speaker

explanation.surface: A nasty-minded public speaker comes in and remains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turned' makes MIA, and 'enters' sends the speaker between its first letter and the rest. Moratoria is the plural of moratorium, so it matches the plural 'stays'.
explanation.definitionFit: Moratoria are suspensions or postponements, as are stays of execution.
